dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどんなご相談ですか
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 会社の上司とうまくいかないです。
dialogue.content: I’m having trouble getting along with my manager at work.

dialogue.origin: 上司の方との関係ですねうまくいかないのはお辛いですね
dialogue.content: So, it's about your relationship with your manager. That must be tough for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、この4月から上司が変わり新しい上司になりやりにくくなりました。
dialogue.content: Yes, my manager changed this April, and I'm finding it difficult to work with the new one.

dialogue.origin: この4月からの新しい上司の方なのですね
dialogue.content: So this is a new manager who started this April, correct?

dialogue.origin: 前の上司とはうまくいっていたんです。
dialogue.content: I got along well with my previous manager.

dialogue.origin: 新しい上司の方とはうまくいかない。と
dialogue.content: But you're not getting along with the new manager, I see.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 具体的にどんなことがありますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more specifically what's been happening?

dialogue.origin: 仕事量が増えたのに、残業するなと言ってきます。
dialogue.content: My workload has increased, but I’m being told not to work overtime.

dialogue.origin: お仕事の量も増えた上に残業はしてはならないと。理不尽ですね
dialogue.content: So your workload has increased, and on top of that, you're not supposed to work overtime. That sounds unreasonable.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、それにコロナで在宅になり作業効率も悪いんです。
dialogue.content: Exactly. Plus, I'm working from home because of COVID, and my efficiency has dropped.

dialogue.origin: 在宅でもあるのですねそれならもっと仕事が普段通りにいかないですよね
dialogue.content: You're working from home as well. I can imagine that makes it even harder to get work done as usual.

dialogue.origin: はい、家には子供がいて保育園に預けることもできないので残業するしかないんですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, my child is at home and I can't send them to daycare, so I have no choice but to work overtime.

dialogue.origin: でも残業が多すぎるとブラック企業になるから、なるべくしないようにと言われます。
dialogue.content: But I'm told to avoid it as much as possible because too much overtime would make the company look like an exploitative workplace.

dialogue.origin: 新しい事ばかりの環境下でむちゃが多すぎですね！
dialogue.content: That's a lot of unreasonable demands in a completely new environment!

dialogue.origin: じゃ、どうしろと！となりますよね
dialogue.content: It makes you want to ask, 'So what am I supposed to do?!', doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。会社の状況を考えると仕方がないことだとは思うのですが、、サービス残業をしてはいけないと言われるけどするしかない状況です。
dialogue.content: I suppose. I understand it can't be helped given the company's situation, but... I'm told not to do unpaid overtime, and I'm in a situation where I have no other choice.

dialogue.origin: お子さんがいらっしゃて、仕事もはかどり難い職場ではないので新しい環境下
dialogue.content: With a child at home and in an environment where it’s hard to make progress—especially under these new circumstances—

dialogue.origin: 難しい要望ですね
dialogue.content: those are very difficult expectations.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、時間外に資料作りなどの作業をして、メールの送信など時間の履歴の残る仕事は時間内にしています。残業申請をしないで働いている状態です。
dialogue.content: Yes. I do things like prepare documents outside of work hours, and then do tasks that leave a time stamp, like sending emails, during official hours. I'm working without logging my overtime.

dialogue.origin: 時間について色々工夫をされていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So you're finding various ways to manage your time.

dialogue.origin: 残業はつけずに
dialogue.content: Without logging the overtime.

dialogue.origin: 在宅になったのはいつからですか？
dialogue.content: When did you start working from home?

dialogue.origin: 前の上司は仕事量と時間配分を定期的に確認してくれたり、2人で話す時間を2か月に1回ペースで作ってくれていました。
dialogue.content: My previous manager used to regularly check on my workload and time management, and she would make time for us to talk one-on-one about once every two months.

dialogue.origin: 在宅になったのは3月末です
dialogue.content: I started working from home at the end of March.

dialogue.origin: では、前の上司の方とは殆どかぶっていないのですね
dialogue.content: So you hardly overlapped with your previous manager while working from home, then?

dialogue.origin: 折角、良い関係性だった上司の方でしたのに・・・
dialogue.content: And it's a shame, since you had such a good relationship with your previous manager...

dialogue.origin: 前の上司と新しい上司の引継ぎが4月の1か月間ありましたので、その期間は一緒に働いていました
dialogue.content: There was a handover between my previous and new manager throughout April, so during that month we worked together.

dialogue.origin: 前の上司は産休のため上司が交代になったのです
dialogue.content: The change happened because my previous manager went on maternity leave.

dialogue.origin: 1ヶ月はご一緒に働かれ、産休で新しい上司の方になられたのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you worked together for a month, and then she went on maternity leave and the new manager took over.

dialogue.origin: 前の上司は年下で、彼女にとって部下は全員年上だったので、いろんなことに気を使ってくれていたのかもしれません。。
dialogue.content: My previous manager was younger, and all her subordinates were older than she was, so she may have been very considerate about many things.

dialogue.origin: とても気配りがお出来になる信頼関係もあった方の様ですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like she was very thoughtful and you had a relationship built on trust.

dialogue.origin: 新しい上司は、男性なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is your new manager a man?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。仕事が早く気配りも抜かりない方でした。
dialogue.content: Yes. She was efficient and thorough in her attentiveness.

dialogue.origin: 新しい上司も女性です。少し年上です。
dialogue.content: The new manager is also a woman, a bit older than me.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね素敵な方ですね
dialogue.content: I see. She sounds like a wonderful person.

dialogue.origin: 新しい上司の方も同性ですか年は上なのですね
dialogue.content: So your new manager is also a woman, and older than you.

dialogue.origin: 上司という立場上、ちょっと強引でもいいと思ってる節はあると思います。きっとこれが一般的なんでしょうね。。
dialogue.content: I get the sense that, in her position as a manager, she feels it’s acceptable to be a bit forceful. Perhaps that’s how it generally is.

dialogue.origin: 部署は全員女性です。
dialogue.content: Everyone in my department is a woman.

dialogue.origin: 一般的に思われるかもしれませんが前の方との関係性が良かっただけに苦しい感じですね
dialogue.content: That may be common, but precisely because you had such a good relationship with your previous manager, this feels tough.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。ぬるま湯につかってしまっていたのかもしれません。。
dialogue.content: Yes. Maybe I had gotten too comfortable.

dialogue.origin: ぬるま湯？なんとなくこの状況が仕方がないかも。とも感じる部分もおありなのですか？
dialogue.content: “Too comfortable”? Do you also feel, in some ways, that the situation might be unavoidable?

dialogue.origin: はい、自分ではどうしようもないので。。
dialogue.content: Yes, because there’s nothing I can do about it myself...

dialogue.origin: 新しい上司とうまくいかない、環境下も大きく変わったブラック企業と言われたくない会社の方針に従うのも致し方ない気持ちにもなられていらっしゃる感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: So it sounds like you're feeling that you have no choice but to accept things—not getting along with the new manager, the big changes in your environment, and the company's policy of wanting to avoid being seen as an exploitative workplace. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それに、仕事量のコントロールを前の上司がしてくれていた分、前の上司に負担をかけていた部分もあったんだろうなと思います。今の上司はお子さんがいらっしゃるので自分が仕事を抱えるわけにもいかず強引になるしかないのかなとも思います。
dialogue.content: Also, the previous manager managed my workload for me, so I think I may have been placing a burden on her. My current manager has a child, so perhaps she can’t take on extra work herself and has no choice but to be more forceful.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話しをお伺いしていると年下とはいえ前の上司のかたとはうまくいっていたのに
dialogue.content: Hearing all this, even though she was younger, you got along well with your previous manager, and yet—

dialogue.origin: 年下だから気を使ってくれていたんだと思います
dialogue.content: I think she was considerate because she was younger.

dialogue.origin: うまくいかない新しい上司の事もかばって？おられるように感じるのですが
dialogue.content: It feels like you're almost defending the new manager you're not getting along with. Is that the case?

dialogue.origin: かばうというより、ワーキングマザーの視点でみると仕方がない状況かなと。。
dialogue.content: It's not so much defending her, but from the perspective of a working mother, I feel it's a situation that can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: あー！そうなんですね
dialogue.content: Ah, I see!

dialogue.origin: 年下で気を使ったり、負担を背負ってくれていたのはシングルだったからだと思いなんですね
dialogue.content: So you think your previous manager, who was younger, was able to be so considerate and take on more of the burden because she didn't have children?

dialogue.origin: ご結婚はされていましたがお子さんはいらっしゃいませんでした。結構残業されていました。
dialogue.content: She was married but didn’t have children. She often worked overtime.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: うまくいかない新しい上司は同じワーキングマザーとして納得できる部分もおありなのですね
dialogue.content: So, as a fellow working mother, there are parts of your new manager's situation that you can understand, even if you're not getting along.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、新しい仕事を在宅ワークで始めることになり、彼女なりにいっぱいいっぱいなのは感じます。。
dialogue.content: Yes. Starting a new role while working from home, I can sense she’s overwhelmed in her own way.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: ご自身もお辛いのに上司の事も理解しようとされてる感じですね
dialogue.content: Even though you’re having a hard time yourself, it seems you’re trying to understand your manager as well.

dialogue.origin: 新しい上司に対する不満ではなく、サービス残業をしていることに不満があるのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Maybe my dissatisfaction isn't with my new manager, but with the fact that I'm doing unpaid overtime.

dialogue.origin: なるほど！
dialogue.content: I see!

dialogue.origin: サービス残業の不満ですか
dialogue.content: Dissatisfaction with the unpaid overtime?

dialogue.origin: 結局はそういうことだと今気づきました。
dialogue.content: I’ve just realized that that’s what it comes down to.

dialogue.origin: そうですか！
dialogue.content: Is that so!

dialogue.origin: ただ、前の上司の様に定期的な話しなど出来るといい関係は築けそうな感じはしますが
dialogue.content: Still, I feel that, like with your previous manager, if you could have regular conversations, you might be able to build a good relationship.

dialogue.origin: 仕方がない状況だといえ、上司とのやり取りで強引さを感じ不快な思いはしていますが。。そうですね、定期的に話し合いがあるといいですね。でも現状コロナの影響で仕事量も多く在宅で作業効率も落ちているのでそういう時間をとれないのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Even if I tell myself the situation can't be helped, I do feel uncomfortable with how forceful she is in our interactions... But yes, it would be nice to have regular discussions. But with the impact of COVID, the workload is heavy and efficiency is down while working from home, so maybe she just can't make time for that.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 定期的な話が出来たら上司と部下といえ
dialogue.content: If you could have regular conversations, even as manager and subordinate—

dialogue.origin: 良き仕事仲間として、この困難な会社の体制も気持ち的に楽になるといいですよね
dialogue.content: as good colleagues, it would be nice if you could feel more mentally at ease with the company's difficult situation.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、30分でいいから雑談でもできると変わるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: Yes, even 30 minutes of casual conversation might make a difference.

dialogue.origin: 普段ならランチとかできますが、在宅だとそれもしませんしね。
dialogue.content: Normally we could go to lunch, but working from home, we don't do that.

dialogue.origin: そうですね時間がお互いとれると少しお電話でもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Yes, if you both could find the time, maybe even a short phone call would be nice.

dialogue.origin: それはちょっと気まずいですが。。笑
dialogue.content: That would be a bit awkward... (laughs)

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・失礼いたしました笑
dialogue.content: I see... my apologies. (laughs)

dialogue.origin: 会ったことない上司と急に電話で他愛のない話はできないです(笑)
dialogue.content: I can’t suddenly make small talk on the phone with a manager I’ve never met in person. (laughs)

dialogue.origin: サービス残業に
dialogue.content: About the unpaid overtime—

dialogue.origin: あ！在宅のまま上司になられてので面識もないのですよね
dialogue.content: Oh! So she became your manager while you were already working from home, so you've never met in person, have you?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、PC上の会議でたまに顔を合わせてますが、仕事の話だけで終わります
dialogue.content: Exactly. We see each other's faces occasionally in online meetings, but we only talk about work.

dialogue.origin: そういう状況だったのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the situation.

dialogue.origin: 今度、会議の延長でお二人でお話しができるとよいですね
dialogue.content: It would be nice if you could talk, just the two of you, after a meeting sometime.

dialogue.origin: 会議の最初に２．３分他愛のない話タイムはありますけどね。
dialogue.content: We do have two or three minutes of small talk at the beginning of meetings, though.

dialogue.origin: あー！そんな時間でもよいですよね！
dialogue.content: Oh! Even a little time like that is good, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: でもやっぱり二人きりで仕事全体について話す機会が欲しいですね。
dialogue.content: But I really would like a chance to talk about my overall work, just the two of us.

dialogue.origin: 前の上司のやり方に固執してしまっているのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Maybe I’m fixated on how my previous manager did things.

dialogue.origin: それはとても有意義な事だと私はかんじますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I feel that would be very meaningful. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: それとは？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by “that”?

dialogue.origin: 定期的なお二人の話しの時間
dialogue.content: Having regular one-on-one time for discussion.

dialogue.origin: すみません、ちょっと意味がわからないです
dialogue.content: I’m sorry, I’m not quite sure what you mean.

dialogue.origin: ご提案なのですが、お二人で話される機会がある時、定期的に仕事についての話し合う時間を設けるご提案をなさってみるのはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: It's just a suggestion, but when you have a chance to talk, how about suggesting that you set aside some time to discuss work on a regular basis?

dialogue.origin: 会議の最初に２．３分他愛のない話タイムを作っているのは今の上司で、定期的な2人の話し合いをしていたのは前の上司です
dialogue.content: The current manager is the one who created the two- or three-minute small talk at the start of meetings, and it was my previous manager who had regular one-on-one meetings.

dialogue.origin: 新しい上司の方への提案ですしっくりこない感じですかね
dialogue.content: Suggesting it to your new manager might not feel quite right, perhaps?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、こちらから折を見て1ON1の提案を持ち掛けてみます。今はとても忙しそうですので、しばらくして様子をみます。
dialogue.content: Right. I will try to suggest a one-on-one when I see a good opportunity. She seems very busy right now, so I'll wait a while and see how things go.

dialogue.origin: そですね、そんな機会があるとよいですが・・サービス残業への不満との事の折り合いはご自身の中で解消されそうですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, it would be good to have that opportunity... Regarding your dissatisfaction with unpaid overtime, do you feel you'll be able to come to terms with it yourself?

dialogue.origin: サービス残業については、、子供を保育園に預けられるようになれば作業効率も上がるので少しは解決するかもしれません
dialogue.content: About the unpaid overtime... once I can send my child to daycare, my work efficiency will improve, so that might solve it to some extent.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねでは、それまではほんの少しのお時間でもご自身の為に有意義な時間が持てると気晴らしになるかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I see. Well then, until that time, it might be a nice change of pace if you can have even a little meaningful time for yourself.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、自分のための時間、大切ですね。。日々の忙しさにそのことをわすれてしまっていました。
dialogue.content: Yes, time for myself... that's important, isn't it? I had forgotten about that in the hustle and bustle of daily life.

dialogue.origin: お話しをお伺いしていて、お仕事とお子様のことに全力投球されてる感じがしていました
dialogue.content: Listening to you, I got the feeling you were putting all your energy into your work and your child.

dialogue.origin: 子供といると自分の時間がないですしね
dialogue.content: When you're with a child, you don't have any time for yourself.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！
dialogue.content: That’s so true!

dialogue.origin: 同じ食事の支度をするのもご自身のウキウキクッキングなどできるとよいかな。とも感じます
dialogue.content: Even with something like meal prep, perhaps finding a way to make it your own little bit of “happy cooking” time could be nice.

dialogue.origin: ウキウキクッキング。。それは何でしょうか？とりあえず、保育園が再開される日は近いのでそれを待ちます。
dialogue.content: “Happy cooking”... what would that be? In any case, daycare should be reopening soon, so I’ll wait for that.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい、では保育園が早く再開されることをながっています。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, well, I hope daycare reopens soon for you. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: (今日はありがとうございましたこれで終了で大丈夫ですか？)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for today. Is it okay to end the session now?)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: SVって入ってたんでしょうか。。？
dialogue.content: Was a supervisor (SV) present?

dialogue.origin: この画面には現れませんが、外部からみられてるようです
dialogue.content: They don’t appear on this screen, but it seems they’re observing from outside.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！仕組みをよくわかっていなくて。。これについてのコメントとかはどこかで見ることはできるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Oh, I see! I didn't really understand how it works... Is there anywhere I can see comments about this session?

dialogue.origin: 本当に今日はありがとうございました又、お会い出来た時はよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for today. I look forward to working with you again if we have the chance.

dialogue.origin: コメントは
dialogue.content: As for comments—

dialogue.origin: 特に無いです。実践コースのレポート提出で終了です。
dialogue.content: There aren't any, really. It just ends with submitting the report for the practical course.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。レポートの提出で終了なのですね。本日はありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you for letting me know. So it ends with submitting the report. Thank you for today!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。おやすみなさい。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Good night.

topic.sub: 新しい上司とのコミュニケーションの取り方
